pontes.chamada: What your organization connects from outside into Alumia and from inside out. All with open rules: a bot always carries its label, Telegram only gets what is already public.
pontes.semOrg: You don't manage any organization on Alumia. Bots and Telegram belong to organizations.

robos.chamada: A bot account posts through the API: strike notices, schedules, bulletins. It always carries the BOT label and the organization's name, and that cannot be removed.
robos.semSelo: Without the seal, each bot waits for the coordination to approve it before posting.
robos.nomeAjuda: 3 to 40 characters. This is the name shown on posts.
robos.descricaoAjuda: 10 to 300 characters. Shown on the bot's profile.
robos.usoHoje: {n} posts in the last 24 hours (up to {max})
robos.trocarAviso: The old key stops working right away.
robos.chaveUmaVez: Copy it now: it won't be shown again. Alumia keeps only a digest of it and cannot show it a second time.
robos.desligarConfirma: Turn off {nome}? The key stops working and the bot no longer posts. Its posts stay, with the label.
robos.desligadoTexto: Turned off for good: the key no longer works. Its posts keep the label. To publish again, create a new bot.
robos.recusadoTexto: The coordination did not approve this bot. It does not publish. To try again, create another and explain better what it is for.

fila.chamada: Requests from organizations without the seal. Check the name and what the bot is for before approving.

telegram.chamada: The organization's posts for the internet also go out on its Telegram channel, ten minutes after publishing. Anything deleted or held in the meantime does not go out. Posts for members, for followers and from closed communities never go out.
telegram.semSelo: Only an organization with the seal can connect a channel.
telegram.passo1: On Telegram, make the Instituto Lúcia bot an administrator of the channel, with permission to post only.
telegram.passo2: Write the channel's @ here (or its number, if the channel is private).
telegram.ligado: On. The last post went out on {data}.
telegram.ligadoNunca: On. No post has gone out yet.
telegram.falhas: Turned off by itself: Telegram refused five sends in a row. Check that the bot is still an administrator of the channel and turn it on again.
telegram.invalido: That channel does not look like a Telegram channel.

api.chamada: One request per post, with the key in the header. Limit of {hora} posts per hour and {dia} per day. The text goes through the same screening as anyone's.
api.publicos: "publico" accepts "internet" (anyone) or "membros" (only people with an Alumia account). A bot does not post in communities or cells.
api.respostas: Responses: 201 posted; 401 wrong key; 403 bot stopped; 429 over the limit; 422 personal data in the text.
api.segredo: Keep the key like a password: in a password manager or in a variable on the bot's server, never in the code.

rotulo.explica: This profile is a bot: a program of the organization posts here, not a person.

traduzir.nota: Translated by the Instituto Lúcia server. It may contain mistakes.

resumo.chamada: Once a week, by email, the titles of public posts in the communities you choose. Only the titles: nothing of the text, nothing about who wrote it.
resumo.semComunidades: None of your communities can go into the digest. It only carries public titles, and only open subject communities publish outside Alumia; the struggle and Institute communities stay among members.
resumo.previa: See what would be sent now
resumo.previaVazia: There are no new titles in these communities this week.
resumo.outro: This is one email. The notifications digest (counts and titles of public conversations) is another, switched on separately in Notifications > Preferences.

mural.chamada: Strikes, assemblies, campaigns and solidarity funds from organizations with a seal. Each call leaves the board by itself on its set date.
mural.encerrarConfirma: Close this call? It leaves the board.
mural.categoriaAjuda: Who is in the struggle: subway workers, state school teachers, delivery riders…
mural.textoAjuda: What it is, what the workers demand and how to support. No personal phone or email.
mural.ateAjuda: At most {n} days. Without a date: 30 days.

problema.cidade: The city has up to 60 characters.
problema.ate: The deadline goes from today to 90 days.
problema.quando: The date must be between today and the deadline.

mural.solidaria: Looking for people who live from their own work? The site's solidarity economy board is still in the same place.
mural.porque: Why only organizations with the seal
mural.porqueTexto: A fake strike call demobilizes. The seal says the account belongs to who it claims to be (it is not an endorsement by the Institute), and each call shows the organization that posted it.

ajustes.robosChamada: For people who manage an organization.
ajustes.soMembro: The community digest by email and the organization's bots are for Alumia members.

erros.desligado: This is not turned on yet.
erros.entre_primeiro: Sign in to your account first.
erros.consentimento: Only people who have joined Alumia can do this.
erros.sem_permissao: You cannot do this for that organization.
erros.dado_pessoal: Remove the personal phone, email or document from the text.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many requests in a row. Wait a little.
erros.ja_decidido: This request has already been decided.
erros.sem_servico: The server is not configured for this.
erros.falha: It did not work. Try again.
erros.alumia_entrada: Sign in with an approved account.
